sha_convention: bytes on disk as-is (binary read, no line-ending normalization)

goal_parse.current_blocker: the full `avir-cli` parity harness gate has emitted `receipts\ember-preloop-resident-gate\avir-cli-full-parity-harness-gate-20260621T190451Z.json` with `AVIR_CLI_FULL_PARITY_HARNESS_GATE_BLOCKED`. The receipt consumes the inventory and bootstrap receipts, reads the legal/reference boundary, and records a 13-row surface matrix for function, UI/UX, backend/coordinator, launch, process supervision, hooks, tool dispatch/permissions, state, receipts, rollback, communication, native goal mode, and clean-room legal boundary. It classifies the previous adapter as `HEADLESS_BOOTSTRAP_ONLY`, records `full_cleanroom_parity_not_implemented`, and proves no full-parity surface is deletion-sensitive yet. The first load-bearing missing surface to implement is `native_goal_organ`, because Codex-style goal mode must become a resident Ember mechanism before any RLM/iGRPO training can learn to operate the harness.
goal_parse.required_receipt: a new `receipts\ember-preloop-resident-gate\native-goal-organ-<timestamp>.json` with either `NATIVE_GOAL_ORGAN_PASS` proving a clean-room resident goal organ implements parse/read/select/compile/act-or-delegate/verify/write/preserve and deletion of that organ blocks or degrades the cycle, or `NATIVE_GOAL_ORGAN_BLOCKED` naming the exact missing mechanism, permission, reference, or implementation surface and the next executable command. A prompt-only plan, static routing table, Codex manual steering trace, or headless adapter is not a pass.
goal_parse.kill_ablate_test: deleting or disabling the native goal organ must block current-blocker selection and next-action preservation while leaving receipt parsing alone insufficient. If a static template, Codex goal mode, or manual steering can continue the cycle without the organ, the receipt fails.
goal_parse.next_blocker_if_pass: rerun `python scripts\ember_avir_cli_full_parity_harness_gate.py --out receipts\ember-preloop-resident-gate\avir-cli-full-parity-harness-gate-<timestamp>.json` and continue the next missing full-parity surface named by that receipt. Only after all required full-parity rows pass may the goal proceed to the RLM/iGRPO neural resident-training organ.
goal_parse.next_blocker_if_fail: continue the exact missing native-goal-organ surface named by the receipt. Do not run additional D3/Kaggle/PaperBench/RE-Bench/ ScienceAgentBench loops, readiness checks, duration milestones, documentation passes, or remote GitHub performance work as substitutes.

native_goal_organ.implemented_surface: parse goal, read receipts, select current blocker, compile bounded action, verify, write receipt, preserve next blocker

compiled_action.allowed_effect: rerun full parity gate with native goal organ evidence

bounded_action.delegation_policy: native organ emits the exact bounded local command; caller may execute it, but next action selection is preserved in the receipt

deletion_ablation.method: delete organ source or replace selection with receipt-only reader; selected blocker/action preservation no longer has an executable owner
